description: Inputs passed to the Arkham adaptive-counterparty policy WASM at evaluation time

sender_address.description: The wallet initiating the payment (0x-prefixed). Its counterparty history and outflow baseline are what the policy measures against.

destination_address.description: The proposed recipient (0x-prefixed). Matched against the sender's known counterparties to decide whether this is an established relationship or a new one.

chains.description: Comma-separated Arkham chain identifiers scoping the counterparty and flow lookups (e.g. 'ethereum' or 'ethereum,base'). REQUIRED: unscoped, /flow/address returns every chain's full daily history - over 1MB for an active wallet, which exhausts the WASM heap. Scoping to one chain brings it to roughly 270KB.

transaction_amount_usd.description: USD notional of the proposed payment. CALLER-SUPPLIED and therefore NOT attested - see this pack's README. Defaults to 0 when omitted.

history_window_days.description: Lookback window (1-365 days) for counterparty aggregation and the outflow baseline. Defaults to 90. Out-of-range values are rejected by the WASM, and the Rego then denies on the oracle error.
